And then kill them again!|audio = TakeoverMasterWave13.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 13 ([[The Takeover Event]], Master)}} }} ==Description== The '''Molten Necromancer''' is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. It also appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. Additionally, while it does not spawn there naturally, it can also be sent by a player in Molten Arena [[PVP]]. It has a decent amount of health, being close to half of the [[Molten Golem]]'s health and it walks at about the same speed as the [[Molten]]. It has a single ability, where it summons two [[Molten Demon]]s. These have a 30% chance to be [[Nimble]]. ==Appearance== The '''Molten Necromancer''' has completely crimson skin, with dark crimson bands on its right arm and legs. It has two heads, each with one eye and multiple teeth. Its left arm has been burnt, turning its color into charcoal black. It wears two black chains which form an X on its torso and a brown belt, which has two skulls with glowing eyes attached to it. It carries a molten scythe. ==Strategy== *The '''Molten Necromancer''' can be a threat when it first appears, as it can summon many [[Molten Demon]]s if not killed quickly, creating hordes, especially in groups. **Early game towers like the [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]], [[Military Base]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can take care of the '''Molten Necromancer''' quite quickly. **High DPS towers like the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Crook Boss]] can also be quite useful. ***Do note that the [[Accelerator]], if locked onto the '''Molten Necromancer''' or other strong enemies, will ignore the [[Molten Demon]]s the '''Molten Necromancer''' summons until the targeted enemy is defeated or leaves its range. ***The [[Ranger]] may struggle against the hordes of [[Molten Demon]]s the '''Molten Necromancer''' summons due to its slow firerate. Additionally, it will be unable to attack its summons as they are [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Tesla]] can be quite useful as they can damage both the '''Molten Necromancer''' and the [[Molten Demon]]s it summons. *Do note that you do not earn any money from the summoned enemies. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MoltenNecro.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2MoltenNecromancer.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMoltenNecromancer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Enforcer Trailer -
